Final selection removes the rejected GPU changes and scratch state; its CPU F16 mathematics is the measured implementation. F32 CPU and GPU paths are restored to the frozen preceding implementation, apart from the F16-only addition. No historical sample is represented as a fresh measurement of the final executable.
